description: This file defines a Python class CppWrapperCpuArrayRef for generating C++ wrappers for CPU tensors using ArrayRef, including methods for code generation, memory management, and kernel calls within the PyTorch AOT Inductor project.

classes.name: CppWrapperCpuArrayRef
classes.description: A class for generating C++ wrapper code for CPU tensors using ArrayRef, supporting kernel calls, memory management, and codegen with minimal arrayref interface.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the CppWrapperCpuArrayRef instance, asserting device support and setting stack allocation config.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of CppWrapperCpuArrayRef, supporting subgraph codegen (currently returns a new instance).

methods.name: get_input_cpp_type
methods.description: Returns the C++ type string for a given input, supporting sympy.Expr and tensor types.

methods.name: get_device_include_path
methods.description: Returns the include path for array_ref.h depending on the device and AOT mode.

methods.name: codegen_input_numel_asserts
methods.description: Generates assertions for input tensor element counts.

methods.name: generate_extern_kernel_alloc
methods.description: Disables stack allocation and calls superclass method for external kernel allocation.

methods.name: generate_extern_kernel_out
methods.description: Disables stack allocation and calls superclass method for external kernel output.

methods.name: generate_fallback_kernel
methods.description: Disables stack allocation and calls superclass method for fallback kernels.

methods.name: _generate_kernel_call_helper
methods.description: Generates code for calling a kernel, handling argument preparation and debug info.

methods.name: write_wrapper_decl
methods.description: Generates wrapper declarations, including AOT model setup, input/output handling, and runtime checks.

methods.name: generate_return
methods.description: Generates code to handle returning outputs, including thread-local caching and output conversion.

methods.name: memory_plan
methods.description: Performs memory planning for the generated code.

methods.name: memory_plan_reuse
methods.description: Reuses memory buffers based on previous plans, considering nested scopes.

methods.name: can_stack_allocate_buffer
methods.description: Checks if a buffer can be stack-allocated based on size, shape, and device.

methods.name: make_buffer_free
methods.description: Generates code to free a buffer if needed.

methods.name: make_buffer_allocation
methods.description: Generates code to allocate a buffer.

methods.name: make_allocation
methods.description: Creates code for tensor buffer allocation, supporting stack reuse if possible.

methods.name: make_buffer_reuse
methods.description: Generates code to reuse or reinterpret buffers.

methods.name: _assert_safe_to_use_borrow_arrayref_tensor_as_tensor
methods.description: Asserts that it is safe to borrow an ArrayRef tensor as a regular tensor.

methods.name: is_safe_to_use_borrow_arrayref_tensor_as_tensor
methods.description: Checks if it is safe to borrow ArrayRef tensors as regular tensors.

methods.name: generate_c_shim_extern_kernel_call
methods.description: Generates code to call an external C shim kernel, handling argument wrapping.

methods.name: generate_scatter_fallback
methods.description: Disables stack allocation for scatter fallback and calls superclass method.

methods.name: _generate_scatter_fallback
methods.description: Generates code for scatter fallback kernel call with argument wrapping.

methods.name: generate_index_put_fallback
methods.description: Disables stack allocation for index put fallback and calls superclass method.

methods.name: _generate_index_put_fallback
methods.description: Generates code for index put fallback with argument wrapping.

methods.name: generate_fallback_kernel_with_runtime_lookup
methods.description: Disables stack allocation for fallback kernel with runtime lookup.

methods.name: codegen_device_copy
methods.description: Generates code for device-to-device tensor copy, disabling stack allocation.

methods.name: codegen_reinterpret_view
methods.description: Returns a handle for a reinterpreted tensor view, creating new handle if needed.

methods.name: val_to_arg_str
methods.description: Converts a value to a C++ argument string, handling optional tensors.

methods.name: codegen_tensor_item
methods.description: Generates code to extract a tensor item as a scalar, supporting float16 and other types.
